audit.name: Suzzallo Library
audit.notes: Photo-referenced west reading hall, thirteen Gothic window bays, three physically recessed portals, broad short stair and continuous raised terrace; Explore faces the entrance from Red Square.

audit.name: Alder Hall
audit.notes: Retain the dedicated open courtyard, shopfront/arcade, whole-block and transit modeling. No geometry changes.

audit.name: Gerberding Hall
audit.notes: Retain the junction tower, lower mapped wings, louvres, stone courses and attached pinnacles.

audit.name: Denny Hall
audit.notes: Retain sandstone walls, slate silhouette and supported octagonal cupola.

audit.name: Mary Gates Hall
audit.notes: Retain Gothic perimeter wings, lower commons roof and central glazing.

audit.name: Savery Hall
audit.notes: Retain mapped wings, sloped slate roof margins, inner flat roof and masonry/stone window bays; reviewed against core aerial.

audit.name: Raitt Hall
audit.notes: Retain mapped wings and existing Gothic facade/roof system; reviewed against core aerial.

audit.name: Smith Hall
audit.notes: Retain mapped wings and existing Gothic facade/roof system; reviewed against core aerial.

audit.name: Gowen Hall
audit.notes: Retain mapped wings and existing Gothic facade/roof system; reviewed against core aerial.

audit.name: Kane Hall
audit.notes: Recessed south portico, continuous concrete piers and tall back-set glazing replace stacked small windows.

audit.name: Odegaard Library
audit.notes: Three-storey brick/glass library behind a concrete bay frame; broad central skylight follows the aerial.

audit.name: Student Union Building
audit.notes: Historic brick east enclosure, lower central volumes and distinct glazed north/south public entries.

audit.name: Burke Museum of Natural History and Culture
audit.notes: Retain the existing timber enclosure, tall narrow glazing and closed street-aligned shed roof.

audit.name: Henry Art Gallery
audit.notes: Two-storey original gallery with masonry/stone courses and slate margins; AVA is its separately mapped modern addition.

audit.name: PACCAR Hall
audit.notes: Brick wings, public glass atrium and a supported projecting glazed meeting-room volume.

audit.name: William H. Gates Hall
audit.notes: Warm masonry outer L, south/east glazed elevations and four grounded law-library lawn skylights.

audit.name: Paul G. Allen Center for Computer Science & Engineering
audit.notes: Brick teaching wings, seven-storey bay rhythm, shallow window cheeks and a separately glazed circulation atrium.

audit.name: Bill & Melinda Gates Center for Computer Science & Engineering
audit.notes: Staggered terracotta/brick piers, larger glazing, roof event enclosure, terrace and narrow roof lanterns.

audit.name: Life Sciences Building
audit.notes: Glazed laboratory bar, reddish circulation end, teaching plinth, bounded south solar-glass fins and roof PV.

audit.name: Hans Rosling Center for Population Health
audit.notes: Recessed glazed base, concrete pilotis, west solar sails, quieter precast service face and two inset roof terraces.

audit.name: Health Sciences Education Building
audit.notes: Opaque corrugated silver classroom skin, varied tall openings, glazed north active edge and timber floor-edge accents.

audit.name: UW Medical Center - Montlake, Wing SA - Montlake Tower
audit.notes: Separate diagnostic/service podium, glazed patient tower, repeated pale bay edges and lower companion roofs.

audit.name: Husky Stadium
audit.notes: Retain the dedicated stepped bowl, separate upper decks, cantilever roofs, field axis and supports; aerial checked.

audit.name: Hec Edmundson Pavilion
audit.notes: Pitched main arena roof, lower north gym/east annex volumes and the historic west brick/window/pier rhythm.

audit.name: Conibear Shellhouse
audit.notes: Lower shell-storage bays, upper olive/wood-clad dining/academic enclosure and a supported lake-facing deck. The lake-facing DEM sample is the lower floor datum, rather than the central uphill entrance sample.

audit.name: Intellectual House
audit.notes: Retain the existing cedar longhouse, sloped closed roof, timber posts and grounded approach.

audit.name: Interdisciplinary Engineering Building
audit.notes: Completed dark-brick building, open lower covered arrival, varied tall openings and rooftop PV.

audit.name: University of Washington Station
audit.notes: Retain the dedicated glass station, lobby decks, structural bays and connected pedestrian bridge/landings.
